edges.label: Names the line and explains the outage
edges.reason: Censor.NET carries Energoatom’s more specific account. It names the Ferosplavna line and says a fire caused by shelling disconnected it on September 5. This supplies the outage mechanism for Kyiv Independent’s summary.
edges.caveat: Both reports rely on Energoatom. The added detail is from the same operator and provides no independent corroboration.
edges.review_status: AI-assisted proposed comparison; human review pending
edges.direction_reason: C01 supplies a specific part of the evidence reported in KI01. Both articles cite Energoatom.
edges.support_scope: The shelling-related loss of a power connection on September 5.
edges.unsupported_parts: Who fired the shells and whether this was the last grid connection. C03 addresses the last-connection detail separately.

edges.label: Identifies the last grid connection
edges.reason: Censor.NET quotes Energoatom identifying the disconnected line as the last connection to Ukraine’s grid and reporting that reactor 6 then supplied the plant’s own needs. This supports the last-line part of Kyiv Independent’s summary.
edges.caveat: This is added detail from the same Energoatom account. Reactor 6 supplying the plant’s needs is consistent with losing the external grid connection.
edges.review_status: AI-assisted proposed comparison; human review pending
edges.direction_reason: C03 supplies a specific part of the evidence reported in KI01. Both articles cite Energoatom.
edges.support_scope: Loss of the last link between the plant complex and Ukraine’s national grid.
edges.unsupported_parts: Who fired the shells and whether the plant lost its own electricity supply.

edges.label: Aligned withdrawal recommendations
edges.reason: Macron and Halushchenko both recommend Russian troop withdrawal. Their statements give aligned policy positions. Macron’s statement supplies no separate evidence that withdrawal or a demilitarized zone is the only way to ensure safety.
edges.caveat: The positions belong to the quoted officials. The reports do not show either statement responding to the other.
edges.review_status: AI-assisted proposed comparison; human review pending

edges.label: Withdrawal as the route to safety versus a catastrophe risk
edges.reason: Halushchenko calls Russian withdrawal and a demilitarized zone the only way to ensure nuclear safety. Nebenzya warns that Russian withdrawal could cause a catastrophe. The same proposed action is presented as necessary for safety and as a source of danger.
edges.caveat: Nebenzya’s statement is dated August 11 and invokes possible Ukrainian provocations; the minister’s recommendation is reported September 5 and includes a demilitarized zone. Different dates and assumed conditions require review.
edges.review_status: AI-assisted proposed claim relation; human review pending
edges.direction_reason: Analyst-assigned comparison: KI03 is proposed to contradict I02. The arrow follows this source-to-target order.

edges.label: Safety assistance versus necessary withdrawal
edges.reason: Karchaa describes assistance; Halushchenko says troop withdrawal is necessary.
edges.caveat: Providing some safety help does not assert that the plant is safe enough without withdrawal. Do not force a logical contradiction.

method.country_note: Outlet countries describe origin. Claimant countries describe an office, organization or stated residence, not assumed citizenship.
method.claim_type_note: A fact claim is a checkable statement, not a fact verified by this graph. Opinions, predictions, legal positions and promises are marked separately.
method.edge_note: Green arrows point from a supporting claim to the claim receiving support. Grey comparisons have no assigned direction. method.attention_note: Attention is a qualitative reading of the saved article, with paragraph locators; it is not a measured share of words.
method.endorsement_note: A quoted speaker’s view is separate from the article narrator’s view. No outlet-wide position is inferred from one article.
method.cleaning_note: Uses saved recovered text. Kyiv Independent later Most Popular / News Feed material is excluded; original paragraph numbers retained. FT wrapped lines are joined into logical paragraphs.
